mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 55 degrees with dense drizzle at Fireman's Park, and we have a waxing crescent moon overhead.

There is plenty to do with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, ART House 360 events tonight, and Hop Haus Trivia also happening today.
